messages:
alex_h: heads up — telemetry is spiking Xid/ECC errors across us-east1 GPU pool, started ~08:12 UTC. Alert count jumped ~5x.
telemetry-bot: [ALERT] gpu-ecc-rate high on us-east1-gpu-pool (82 events/min) — correlates with higher scheduling backpressure.
priya.g: seeing elevated 503s for short text-gen routes, q depth climbing on provisioner. customers might see slow tail latency.
sasha: digging into node logs, multiple nodes in rack-12 showing Xid(121)/Xid(45) resets and ECC corrected count climbing. example: gpu-rack-12-04.
matt_k: quick check on gpu-rack-12-04: ```sudo nvidia-smi -q | egrep -i "ecc|xid|gpu"
GPU 0:
  ECC errors (Volatile) : 0
  ECC errors (Aggregate) : 134
Xid(121) at kernel: nvidia 525.125
```
alex_h: that matches the telemetry. Capacity impact: autoscaler shows ~18% effective GPU capacity drop in us-east1 after drains. Rebalancer is thrashing some pods.
priya.g: can we route a subset of traffic to eu-west and enable model-fallback to smaller variants to reduce token pressure? We should also notify support/CS for high-traffic tenants.
sasha: starting targeted drain on rack-12 nodes (no-serve tag + cordon). Will not full-decommission until RMA decision. Running health-checks before moving stateful workers.
oncall: approved drain. Ordering RMAs for cards 2/3/5 on gpu-rack-12-0*. Spares pool scaled +4 nodes (on-demand) for 60m to cover capacity — expect ~$1.2k/day cost delta while we stabilize.
matt_k: initiated rebalancer job: `rehome --from rack-12 --to spare-pool --parallel 12` — moving low-priority workloads first. Observed p50 latency +12ms during move, error rate starting to decline.
priya.g: telemetry: after draining 6 nodes error-rate dropped 6% -> 2% in 10m. Still seeing intermittent Xid on one remaining host.
alex_h: plan: continue drain+RMA overnight, monitor ECC counters hourly. If Xid returns post-drain, escalate to firmware/kernel patch route (coordinating with infra-kernel). Also enable temporary routing rule to prefer dedicated instances for enterprise customers to meet SLAs.
sasha: added runbook step: if ECC aggregate > 100 within 1h on a rack, mark rack as candidate for replacement and open RMA. Documenting logs and PCI bus ids for vendor.
priya.g: creating CS notice and internal incident doc. tagging cust-A and cust-B for visibility.
telemetry-bot: incident-created: IN-20260214-1745 referencing playbook 'gpu-flaky-card-triage'. Links: https://pager.redwood/IN-20260214-1745
alex_h: thumbs-up, keep short updates here. If anyone sees Xid 43 or uncorrectable ECC start, escalate to severity-2 immediately and flip fallback routing. :thumbsup:
